profile.headline: Software Infrastructure Engineer @Raytheon
profile.summary:
I’m deeply interested in cyber systems engineering and software development, where I can merge my skills in automation, scripting, and security to build more resilient systems. My experience includes hands-on work with VMware, Nutanix, Ansible, Active Directory, and RedHat, as well as programming in Python, Java, and C++ for automation and data-driven projects.

I’m passionate about solving complex technical problems, strengthening system security, and contributing to the next generation of secure, scalable enterprise solutions. Open to opportunities that bridge systems, cybersecurity, and software development—especially in roles focused on DevSecOps, secure automation, and infrastructure engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll
positions.description: Skills: Red Hat Linux · Bash · Radar

positions.title: Neeley Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Provided IT and AV support across 42 classrooms, 7 conference rooms, and 4 labs, leveraging Web Help Desk proficiency for timely issue resolution and implementing preventive maintenance.
Led IT projects, exemplifying skills in documentation, troubleshooting, and ensuring optimal operations for the entire Neeley School of Business infrastructure.

positions.title: Head Visual Editor
positions.description: Capture photographs for TCU360 media/newspaper, this includes sports events, campus activities, and student organizations. Edit photos using Lightroom and Photoshop. Manage team of staff photographers, assigning them to various campus activities.

positions.title: Housing Student Assistant
positions.description: Serve as a customer service representative for Housing Residence Life (HRL), work as a receptionist for the front desk in the central office, provide residence hall tours, represent HRL at recruiting and informational forums throughout the year, and articulate policies, services and resources provided by HRL and TCU as a whole to students, parents, faculty, staff and other guests.

positions.title: Network Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Managed end-to-end network infrastructure utilizing Layer 3 switches, Firewall/ACLs, IP/subnet management, and authentication tools (Aruba, Arista, Cisco, Panorama, Infoblox, SuperPUTTY) to optimize network performance, bolster security, enable efficient troubleshooting, and promote uptime across headquarters and international offices.

Oversaw network monitoring, issue tracking, and rapid resolution through platforms like Opsview and Freshservice, enabling proactive identification and timely remediation of deficiencies; minimized network disruptions and enhanced reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Transport Layer Security (TLS) · SD-WAN · Routers · OSI Model · Firewalls · System Configuration · Confluence · Desktop Computers · Software Support · Optical Fiber · Cisco IOS · Network Switches · Access Points · Ticketing Systems

positions.title: Marketing Communications Intern
positions.description: Founded in August 2007, the mission of Impossible Possibilities is to inspire students through education. As Media Intern, I manage all of the non-profits media pages/communications and take photos at different scholarship related events hosted by Impossible Possibilities.

organizations.name: Habitat For Humanity
organizations.description: Habitat for Humanity is a international organization with the belief that every man, woman, and child should have safe affordable housing. TCU's Habitat Chapter gives students an opportunity to impact the campus, the Fort Worth Community, and even other countries through projects such as builds, painting days, letter writing campaigns, awareness programs, Collegiate Challenge trips, and more.

organizations.name: Omega Delta Phi Fraternity Inc.
organizations.description: President is the overseer of all academic & service related activities.
